name: X-BURPEES
introduce:
Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides. 

Jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead in the shape of the letter “X”. 

Jump back, put your hands on the ground, kick your legs backward and spread them apart. 

Come back to the start position and repeat.

tips.text: Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
This exercise gets all your major muscle groups involved.
